integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained. Finite verification is supplementary; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Two-prime supports only; no claims on convergence of general trajectories or cardinality-three supports. The classification of fixed points is prior-known; novelty is exclusion of additional periodic points for every two-prime support.
title: No nontrivial positive cycles for any two-prime arithmetic subderivative
